commands.title: Commands
commands.description: Every binference command, with its arguments and options.
commands.intro: Every command of `binference`, with its arguments and options, as its help shows them. Run {help} for the same text in the terminal. Every command also takes these options:
config.title: Config keys
config.description: Every config key in config.json5: what it takes, its default and its environment variable.
config.intro: This binference reads `config.json5` version {version}. Each config key is set in the file, by its variable, or by {flag}, and a later layer wins. A secret is always a secret source, never the secret itself.
notices.title: Notices
notices.description: Every notice binference sends the owner, with an example of its words.
notices.intro: Every notice binference sends the owner in Telegram, the console and the terminal chat, with an example of what the owner reads. The level decides its icon. A notice that can be muted is muted per agent in its notice settings; every other notice always goes, since it tells of a security event, of money, or of the engine or an agent stopping.
operations.title: Engine operations
operations.description: Every operation of the engine protocol: the scope a call needs, what it does, where it is accepted and who answers it.
operations.intro: Every operation of the engine protocol, version {version}, by domain. A client calls an operation by its name; the engine refuses a call whose connection lacks the operation's scope. A read changes nothing, a write changes what the engine stores, and a subscription starts or stops pushes for its connection. An operation answered by no one is part of the protocol, but the engine does not serve it: a call fails with `protocol.unknown_op`.
operations.unserved.inCli: no one: the CLI does it without the engine
operations.when.ownIntent: the caller cancels its own proposal
tools.title: Agent and MCP tools
tools.description: The tools the agent's model calls, and the tools binference mcp serves to MCP clients.
tools.agentIntro: The tools the agent's model may call in a turn, in the order a turn offers them. A read only reads, a proposal opens a card the owner confirms, and a control tool sets an alert or a schedule, saves a note or asks the owner. The web tools need a search key, and `search_x` an X key. Each enabled community plugin adds its own tools.
tools.mcpIntro: The tools `binference mcp` serves to MCP clients, each calling one engine operation. An MCP client holds only the read and propose scopes, so no tool can confirm. A tool that takes a request id returns the first card again when a call is retried with the same id.
tools.summary.token_search: Finds a token's id by its symbol, name or contract address.
tools.summary.addresses: Reads the owner's address book for this agent.
tools.summary.wallets: Reads the agent's own wallets: each one's role, chain and address, and its mode.
tools.summary.portfolio: Reads the agent's balances, positions and profit and loss.
tools.summary.token_info: Reads a token's symbol, name, decimals and last risk check.
tools.summary.token_risk: Checks a token for a honeypot, its tax and its liquidity.
tools.summary.quote: Quotes a swap without proposing it.
tools.summary.tx_status: Reads one proposal's state, card and transactions.
tools.summary.intents: Lists the proposals changed since a time, with their states and cards.
tools.summary.market_scan: Lists new launches or trending tokens on a chain.
tools.summary.wallet_activity: Reads the trades of a wallet the agent tracks.
tools.summary.swap: Proposes a swap of one token for another.
tools.summary.buy: Proposes a buy of a token.
tools.summary.sell: Proposes a sale of a token.
tools.summary.send: Proposes a send to a saved address, the rescue address or a .bnb name.
tools.summary.approval_revoke: Proposes setting a token approval back to zero.
tools.summary.bridge_quote: Quotes a bridge to another chain without proposing it.
tools.summary.bridge: Proposes a bridge to another chain.
tools.summary.staking_options: Lists the validators and pools the agent may stake with, and its stakes.
tools.summary.stake: Proposes a stake with a validator or in a pool.
tools.summary.claim: Proposes a claim of what the venue lets the wallet take back.
tools.summary.order_cancel: Cancels an auto order at once.
tools.summary.alert_create: Sets a price, wallet or launch alert at once.
tools.summary.schedule_create: Sets a schedule that starts a turn at its time.
tools.summary.open_skill: Opens one of the agent's skills.
tools.summary.workspace_write: Saves the owner's strategy or the agent's persona.
tools.summary.first_chat_end: Ends the first chat once the owner's answers are saved.
tools.summary.launchpads: Lists the launchpads on a chain and their settings.
tools.summary.launch_draft: Drafts a token launch that only the owner can start.
tools.summary.ask_owner: Asks the owner a question with answer buttons.
tools.summary.notes_write: Saves a note to the agent's memory.
tools.summary.binference_agents: Lists the owner's agents and their wallets.
tools.summary.binference_token_search: Finds a token's id by its symbol, name or contract address.
tools.summary.binference_wallets: Reads an agent's own wallets with their roles and addresses.
tools.summary.binference_portfolio: Reads an agent's balances, positions and profit and loss.
tools.summary.binference_token_info: Reads a token's symbol, name, decimals and last risk check.
tools.summary.binference_token_risk: Checks a token for a honeypot, its tax and its liquidity.
tools.summary.binference_quote: Quotes a swap without proposing it.
tools.summary.binference_bridge_quote: Quotes a bridge to another chain without proposing it.
tools.summary.binference_staking_options: Lists the validators and pools an agent may stake with.
tools.summary.binference_resolve_name: Reads the address a .bnb name points to.
tools.summary.binference_propose: Proposes a trade, send, bridge or stake, which opens a card.
tools.summary.binference_intent_status: Reads one proposal's state, card and transactions.
tools.summary.binference_order_create: Proposes an auto order, which opens a card.
tools.summary.binference_alert_create: Sets a price, wallet or launch alert.
tools.summary.shell: Runs a command on the owner's machine, away from binference's own files, and reads its output.
tools.summary.shell_job: Reads a running command's new output, or stops it.
tools.summary.browse: Drives a browser of the agent's own on the owner's machine: opens pages, reads them, clicks, types and takes screenshots.
tools.summary.deposit_address: Shows the owner each wallet's address and its QR code, to send funds to the agent.
tools.summary.look_at_image: Looks at a picture at a public address or in a file on the owner's machine and describes it.
tools.summary.look_at_screen: Takes a screenshot of the owner's screen when the owner asks and describes it; it never clicks or types.
tools.summary.read_pdf: Reads PDFs at a public address or on the owner's machine, scanned pages too, and answers a question about them.
tools.summary.file_read: Reads a text file on the owner's machine, a page at a time, or describes an image file.
tools.summary.file_write: Writes a file whole on the owner's machine, making its folders.
tools.summary.file_edit: Makes exact replacements in a file on the owner's machine.
tools.summary.file_patch: Changes several files in one patch, by default inside the agent's workspace.
tools.summary.show_chart: Shows the owner a pie, bar, area or line chart in the chat, or its text where no chart is drawn.
tools.summary.credentials: Lists the owner's stored credentials, asks the owner for a missing one in a masked prompt, or removes one.
tools.summary.http_request: Makes an HTTPS request to an API with the owner's stored credentials, put in by binference only for the hosts the owner allowed; the agent never sees a value.
tools.summary.notes_get: Reads one of the agent's notes in full.
tools.summary.notes_forget: Forgets one of the agent's notes.
tools.summary.make_image: Makes images with the owner's image model, such as a token's logo; they arrive in the chat a little later.
tools.summary.make_video: Makes a short video with the owner's video model on the bInference gateway; it arrives in the chat a few minutes later.
tools.summary.speak: Speaks words as a voice note in the chat, only when the owner asks to hear them.
tools.summary.show_images: Shows the owner, in the chat, pictures already on the machine, such as images the agent made before.
tools.summary.send_files: Sends the owner files on the machine in the chat as documents to save, such as a report or a CSV.
tools.summary.helper_start: Starts a helper: a model run in the background for one bounded task, whose result the agent answers from in a later turn.
tools.summary.helper_list: Lists the agent's helpers with their state and times.
tools.summary.helper_read: Reads one of the agent's helpers: what it does now, its report and its newest messages.
tools.summary.helper_send: Sends a helper a follow-up, which starts another run of it.
tools.summary.helper_stop: Stops one of the agent's running helpers.
tools.summary.agent_status: Reads the agent's own state: its models, model budget, chat, helpers and the time; in its own chat it can switch that chat's model.
tools.summary.goal_set: Sets this chat's goal on the owner's request: an objective the agent keeps working on, turn after turn, until it is done.
tools.summary.goal_read: Reads this chat's goal, its goal turns and spend, and the progress note.
tools.summary.goal_update: Marks this chat's goal complete or blocked, with a short note.
tools.summary.progress_note: Keeps this chat's progress note: a short status and a plan of steps the owner reads beside the chat.
tools.summary.skill_proposal: Proposes a skill, or a change to one of the agent's own skills, for the owner to apply or reject; reads skills and the agent's proposals.
tools.summary.settings_read: Reads the owner's settings, or one key, with secrets shown only as their kind and the rules of each key.
tools.summary.settings_change: Proposes a change to the owner's settings in a card that shows each setting before and after; nothing changes until the owner confirms.
